130:t_004:17.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I can't keep indulging that man's personal tastes.」

130:t_004:18.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We don't have much time...! We'll sweep the enemy quickly!」

130:t_004:20.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll do it...! For Japan, for everyone at $$陣代高校$$...」

130:t_004:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「And for $$シンジ$$ and the others who aren't here, too!!」

130:t_005:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「So Japan has been protected, then.」

130:t_005:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The force dispatched to Japan this time seems to be under a different jurisdiction from the one attacking $$新日本$$.」

130:t_005:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Now that we've struck their commander, $$ダバラーン$$, a second wave isn't likely to come right away.」

130:t_005:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Japan has been protected, hasn't it.」

130:t_005:5.en:
$n
「...Captain $$オットー$$, I have a proposal.」

130:t_005:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「That won't be necessary, $n. I know what you're about to say.」

130:t_005:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And that's the will of all of us, isn't it?」

130:t_005:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, return to the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ immediately. We're heading to $$新日本$$!」

130:t_005:11.en:
$$オットー$$
「We'll show those damned Empire bastards the pride and grit of Earthlings!」

130:t_005:14.en:
$n
(And I believe... that someday, I'll see you all again...)

130:t_006:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now I have the pleasure of crushing you all! I thank the heavens for bringing me to this planet... for making me one of the $$サイデリアル$$!」

130:t_006:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I never want to see you again!」

130:t_006:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Very well! I'll admit defeat here and pull out of Japan for the time being!」

130:t_006:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But this is not the end! I eagerly await the day we meet again on the battlefield!」

130:t_007:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$ and the $$ハイアデス$$... An odd bunch, even among the $$サイデリアル$$.」

130:t_008:0.en:
$$カレン$$
($$シンジ$$... You're not here anymore, but...)

130:t_008:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(I swear...! Just as you fought for the world and the people you cared about, I'll keep fighting too...!)

130:t_008:2.en:
$$カレン$$
(Until the day peace returns to this world I love...!)

130:t_100:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This ship... Both its mobility and its maneuverability are different from any battleship we know...!」

130:t_100:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「It's only natural that you feel that way. This $$アルデバル$$ is the arms and legs of the $$ハイアデス$$, who race across the galaxy!」

130:t_100:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「The legend of the invincible $$ハイアデス$$ lives on with this $$アルデバル$$! No matter how excellent a soldier you are, your defeat is certain!」

130:t_100:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't have time to humor that self-satisfaction...! We're not fighting for fun!」

130:t_101:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's a battleship...! If I get in close...!」

130:t_101:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Naive...! Don't think an obvious tactic like that will work against this $$アルデバル$$!」

130:t_101:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy...! He's the type who enjoys fighting after all!」

130:t_101:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Make your blood boil more! Put your life on the line! Challenge me with your whole body and soul!」

130:t_101:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That is the courtesy owed to one who fights the $$ハイアデス$$!!」

130:t_102:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「A fine machine...! But whether you can make use of it depends on the pilot!」

130:t_102:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is this battleship...!? It's like a giant mobile armor!」

130:t_102:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Have you felt the power of our $$アルデバル$$ firsthand? You seem somewhat capable.」

130:t_102:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But even if you've noticed, it's already too late! You will be an offering to satisfy my fighting instinct!」

130:t_102:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This man... He's different from when we fought before...! Is this his true nature!?」

130:t_103:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think a mere Earth battleship can be a match for the $$アルデバル$$ of the $$ハイアデス$$!」

130:t_103:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「To provoke us on an open channel like this...!」

130:t_103:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「We're not so spineless that we'll stay silent after being treated this contemptuously!」

130:t_103:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「All hands, you heard what he said! We'll throw everything this ship has into meeting him head-on!」

130:t_103:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Show the invaders the grit of $$地球連邦軍$$ soldiers!」

130:t_104:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Come, Reactor! Last time I put the mission first, but today I'll fight you to my heart's content!」

130:t_104:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! The enemy's speed and tactics are completely different from any warship we know!」

130:t_104:2.en:
$n
「If the theories don't work, I'll go on instinct! He seems to want that, too!」

130:t_104:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's right! I have no use for petty combat tricks! Hit me with your very fighting instinct!」

130:t_104:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We became members of the $$サイデリアル$$ to fight battles like this!」

130:t_105:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「You understand, $$カレン$$! The reason we came here...!」

130:t_105:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「We hit the $$サイデリアル$$ right in front of us! That comes first!」

130:t_105:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Got a problem with that, $$スザク$$?」

130:t_105:3.en:
$$スザク$$
「No... that's fine. I won't let them take anything more from us!」

130:t_105:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「Let's do this, $$カレン$$! We hit the $$サイデリアル$$ hard and thorough!」

130:t_106:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'm sorry, $$ノイン$$. Because of me, I've dragged you into another difficult mission.」

130:t_106:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I volunteered of my own accord, $$ゼクス$$.」

130:t_106:2.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Besides, with you and me working together, nothing is difficult.」

130:t_106:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「With those words, I can fight...! Let's go together, $$ノイン$$!」
